column1: # Format: id<TAB>role<TAB>group<TAB>text   ('#' = comment; role = query | document)
# The retrieval model uses task prefixes: role "query" -> "Query: ", "document" ->
# "Document: " (exact strings from the model's config_sentence_transformers.json). The
# llama.cpp side (correctness crate) prepends the literal prefix before tokenizing; the
# FP32 golden side (scripts/gen-golden.py) does NOT prefix by hand — it uses
# sentence-transformers prompt_name=role, which applies the same strings. Equivalent input
#  - emit/compare use EVERY row (each x MEAN and LAST pooling; jina's deployment pooling
#    is LAST, so the golden compares LAST).
#  - selfcheck's semantic-sanity uses the `para*` rows as a paraphrase (positive) pair and
#    the `unrel*` rows as an unrelated (negative) pair.
# EuroBERT-210m backbone is multilingual — cover queries/documents, ASCII and CJK, short/long.
